        if (!pair.endsWith("USDT")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only USDT pairs are supported");
        return pair;
    }
    private BigDecimal positive(BigDecimal value) {
        if (value == null || value.signum() <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Price must be positive");
        return value;
    }

    private WalletManagedPosition newManagedPosition(String pair, TradeSignal signal, BigDecimal executionPrice) {
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        return WalletManagedPosition.builder()
                .symbol(pair)
                .quantity(ZERO)
                .averageEntryPriceUsdt(ZERO)
                .totalCostUsdt(ZERO)
                .status("OPEN")
                .openedAt(now)
                .updatedAt(now)
                .entrySignalId(signal.getId())
                .entryConfidence(signal.getConfidenceScore())
                .entryTotalScore(signal.getTotalScore())
                .entryTrendScore(signal.getTrendScore())
                .entryStructureScore(signal.getTrendStructureScore())
                .entryMomentumScore(signal.getMomentumScore())
                .entryVolumeScore(signal.getVolumeScore())
                .entrySentimentScore(signal.getSentimentScore())
                .entryFundamentalScore(signal.getFundamentalScore())
                .entryDecision(signal.getDecision() == null ? null : signal.getDecision().name())
                .entryDecisionPathJson(signal.getDecisionPath())
                .entryAnalysisSnapshotJson(entrySnapshotJson(signal))
                .stopLossUsdt(signal.getStopLoss())
                .takeProfitUsdt(signal.getTakeProfit())
                .highestPriceUsdt(executionPrice)
                .profitLockActive(false)
                .profitLockPriceUsdt(null)
                .profitLockProgressPercent(BigDecimal.ZERO)
                .profitLockActivatedAt(null)
                .entryStage("NONE")
                .allocatedPositionPercent(0)
                .entryQualityScore(0)
                .lastScaleInAt(null)
                .build();
    }

    private String entrySnapshotJson(TradeSignal signal) {
        java.util.Map<String, Object> snapshot = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        snapshot.put("signalId", signal.getId());
        snapshot.put("symbol", signal.getSymbol());
        snapshot.put("interval", signal.getInterval());
        snapshot.put("generatedAt", signal.getGeneratedAt());
        snapshot.put("entryPriceUsdt", signal.getLatestPrice());
        snapshot.put("decision", signal.getDecision());
        snapshot.put("originalDecision", signal.getOriginalDecision());
        snapshot.put("confidence", signal.getConfidenceScore());
        snapshot.put("totalScore", signal.getTotalScore());
        snapshot.put("trendScore", signal.getTrendScore());
        snapshot.put("structureScore", signal.getTrendStructureScore());
        snapshot.put("momentumScore", signal.getMomentumScore());
        snapshot.put("volumeScore", signal.getVolumeScore());
        snapshot.put("sentimentScore", signal.getSentimentScore());
        snapshot.put("fundamentalScore", signal.getFundamentalScore());
        snapshot.put("stopLossUsdt", signal.getStopLoss());
        snapshot.put("takeProfitUsdt", signal.getTakeProfit());
        snapshot.put("selectedStrategy", signal.getSelectedStrategy());
        snapshot.put("marketRegime", signal.getMarketRegime());
        snapshot.put("analysisBreakdown", signal.getAnalysisBreakdown());
        try {
            return objectMapper.writeValueAsString(snapshot);
        } catch (JsonProcessingException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Could not serialize immutable BUY thesis", ex);
        }
    }
    private BigDecimal nvl(BigDecimal value) { return value == null ? ZERO : value; }
}


===== src/main/java/com/crypto/execution/processing/SignalProcessingCoordinator.java =====
package com.crypto.execution.processing;

import com.crypto.domain.PaperPosition;
import com.crypto.domain.TradeSignal;
import com.crypto.repository.TradeSignalRepository;
import com.crypto.wallet.repository.WalletManagedPositionRepository;
import com.crypto.infrastructure.transaction.InitialPositionLockDeadlock;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;
import org.springframework.transaction.TransactionDefinition;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.function.Function;

/** FIX-127: one coordinator for all Production signal callers. No retry of the
 * existing body after it has begun; only the new initial lock is retry-marked. */
@Service
public class SignalProcessingCoordinator {
    // FIX-125 mandatory in Spring; null only in existing constructor-only policy tests.
    @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired
    private com.crypto.wallet.service.WalletTransactionCoordination walletCoordination;

    private static final Logger log=LoggerFactory.getLogger(SignalProcessingCoordinator.class);
    private final SignalProcessingStore store;
    private final TradeSignalRepository signals;
    private final WalletManagedPositionRepository positions;
    private final SignalProcessingFreshness freshness;
    private final TransactionTemplate transaction;
    public SignalProcessingCoordinator(SignalProcessingStore store, TradeSignalRepository signals,
            WalletManagedPositionRepository positions, SignalProcessingFreshness freshness, PlatformTransactionManager manager) {
        this.store=store;this.signals=signals;this.positions=positions;this.freshness=freshness;
        transaction=new TransactionTemplate(manager);
        transaction.setPropagationBehavior(TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW);
    }
    public Optional<PaperPosition> process(long signalId, boolean background,
            Function<TradeSignal,Optional<PaperPosition>> business) {
        return process(signalId,background,business,null);
    }
    public Optional<PaperPosition> process(long signalId, boolean background,
            Function<TradeSignal,Optional<PaperPosition>> business, Long sourceEventId) {
        if(TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive())
            throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-127 caller must be outside the processing transaction");
        if(!background && !store.exists(signalId)) {
            // Automatic callers have already registered atomically with creation.
            // Explicit existing-signal calls register only at the user's request.
            transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx->store.register(signals.findById(signalId)
                    .orElseThrow(()->new IllegalArgumentException("Signal not found: "+signalId)),ProcessingOrigin.EXPLICIT));
        }
        store.requireSourceOwner(signalId,sourceEventId);
        for(int localAttempt=0;localAttempt<2;localAttempt++) {
            var work=store.claim(signalId,background);
            if(work==null) {
                log.info("[FIX-127][NOT_CLAIMED] signalId={}, background={}; no processing performed",signalId,background);
                return Optional.empty();
            }
            log.info("[FIX-127][ATTEMPT] signalId={}, symbol={}, interval={}, candleOpenTime={}, origin={}, attempt={}, background={}",
                    signalId,work.symbol(),work.interval(),work.candleOpenTime(),work.origin(),work.attempts(),background);
            java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger completion=new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger(-1);
            try {
                Optional<PaperPosition> result=transaction.execute(tx->{
                    org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(
                        new org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronization() {
                            @Override public void afterCompletion(int status) { completion.set(status); }
                        });
                    // FIX-140: observe the real transaction completion; a thrown exception alone
                    // does not prove rollback. The private marker is only created here.
                    if(walletCoordination!=null) {
                        try { walletCoordination.symbol(work.symbol()); }
                        catch(RuntimeException failure) {
                            if(sourceEventId!=null && retryableSymbolLock(failure))throw new SymbolLockFailure(failure);
                            throw failure;
                        }
                    }
                    var owned=store.locked(signalId);
                    if(owned==null || !"RUNNING".equals(owned.status()) || !work.owner().equals(owned.owner()))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-127 processing ownership changed");
                    // Acquire before PositionManagementService inserts a referencing
                    // advisory or executes POSITION_STOP_LOSS. No rules evaluated yet.
                    try {
                        positions.findFirstBySymbolAndStatusOrderByOpenedAtDesc(work.symbol(),"OPEN");
                    } catch(RuntimeException ex) {
                        if(InitialPositionLockDeadlock.isMysqlDeadlock(ex))throw new InitialLockFailure(ex);
                        throw ex;
                    }
                    store.requireSourceOwner(signalId,sourceEventId);
                    // Read signal/freshness after lock acquisition: lock wait must not
                    // consume the recovery grace before it is checked, or establish an
                    // ordinary repeatable-read snapshot before the position is locked.
                    TradeSignal signal=signals.findById(signalId).orElseThrow(()->new IllegalArgumentException("Signal missing"));
                    if(!work.symbol().equals(signal.getSymbol()) || !work.interval().equals(signal.getInterval())
                            || !work.candleOpenTime().equals(signal.getCandleOpenTime()))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-127 signal lineage changed");
                    // FIX-153: every claimed attempt, including the first direct
                    // attempt regardless of origin, is checked after normal locks.
                    if(!freshness.eligible(work))throw new Expired();
                    Optional<PaperPosition> outcome=business.apply(signal);
                    store.complete(work,outcome.map(PaperPosition::getId).orElse(null));
                    return outcome;
                });
                log.info("[FIX-127][COMPLETED] signalId={}, symbol={}, interval={}, attempt={}; processing committed (not necessarily a trade)",
                        signalId,work.symbol(),work.interval(),work.attempts());
                return result;
            } catch(Expired ex) {
                // Only exact RUNNING ownership can expire this attempt, after business TX rolled back.
                if(store.finishWithoutBusiness(work,"EXPIRED","FRESHNESS","Exact candle is no longer latest and fresh")!=1)
                    throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-153 expiry ownership unconfirmed: signal="+signalId);
                log.warn("[FIX-127][EXPIRED] signalId={}, symbol={}, attempt={}",signalId,work.symbol(),work.attempts());
                return Optional.empty();
            } catch(RuntimeException ex) {
                // FIX-140: only this invocation's initial symbol-lock marker plus a
                // confirmed rollback grants retry. Unknown connection/commit failures stay review-only.
                if(ex instanceof SymbolLockFailure && completion.get()==
                        org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronization.STATUS_ROLLED_BACK) {
                    String result=work.attempts()<4?"SYMBOL_LOCK_RETRY":"LOCK_RETRY_EXHAUSTED";
                    int changed=store.finishSymbolLockFailure(work,result,ex.toString());
                    if(changed!=1)throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-140 retry persistence unconfirmed",ex);
                    log.warn("[FIX-140][SAFE_RETRY_RESULT] event={}, signal={}, attempt={}, outcome={}, rollback=CONFIRMED",
                        sourceEventId,signalId,work.attempts(),result);
                    if("SYMBOL_LOCK_RETRY".equals(result))throw new SymbolLockRetryScheduled(signalId);
                    return Optional.empty();
                }
                boolean initial=ex instanceof InitialLockFailure;
                String status=initial && work.attempts()<2 ? "RETRYABLE_FAILURE" : "REVIEW_REQUIRED";
                int recorded=store.finishWithoutBusiness(work,status,initial ? "INITIAL_POSITION_LOCK" : "PROCESSING_OR_COMMIT",ex.toString());
                log.error("[FIX-127][{}] signalId={}, symbol={}, interval={}, attempt={}, initialLock={}",
                        recorded==1 ? status : "FAILURE_RECORD_NOT_UPDATED",signalId,work.symbol(),work.interval(),work.attempts(),initial,ex);
                if(!initial || work.attempts()>=2)throw ex;
                // TransactionTemplate completed rollback before entering this catch.
            }
        }
        return Optional.empty();
    }
    // FIX-140: classify only known lock cancellation/deadlock errors. Communications
    // errors are deliberately excluded even when nested below a data-access exception.
    static boolean retryableSymbolLock(Throwable failure) {
        for(Throwable e=failure;e!=null;e=e.getCause())
            if(e instanceof java.sql.SQLException sql && sql.getSQLState()!=null && sql.getSQLState().startsWith("08"))return false;
        for(Throwable e=failure;e!=null;e=e.getCause())
            if(e instanceof org.springframework.dao.QueryTimeoutException ||
               e instanceof java.sql.SQLTimeoutException ||
               e instanceof java.sql.SQLException sql && (sql.getErrorCode()==1205 || sql.getErrorCode()==1213))return true;
        return false;
    }
    private static final class SymbolLockFailure extends RuntimeException {
        SymbolLockFailure(Throwable cause) { super(cause); }
    }
    // A private marker cannot be supplied by a later business callback.
    private static final class InitialLockFailure extends RuntimeException {
        InitialLockFailure(RuntimeException cause) { super(cause); }
    }
    private static final class Expired extends RuntimeException {}
}


===== src/main/java/com/crypto/market/service/MarketPriceEventService.java =====
package com.crypto.market.service;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * FIX-052 exact Replay/Production parity support.
 *
 * Production protects open positions from every canonical 1m Binance live-price
 * update, not only from candle-close analysis signals. Persisting that exact feed
 * lets Replay evaluate TP/SL/profit-lock against the same observations and order.
 * Timestamps are always stored/interpreted as UTC Instants; timezone conversion is
 * a presentation concern only.
 */
@Service
@org.springframework.context.annotation.DependsOn("localTraderInstance")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MarketPriceEventService {
    private static final int PRICE_SCALE=12;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;
    @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired(required=false) private com.crypto.local.ExchangeClockSynchronizer exchangeClock;

    @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value("${shared-market.mode:OFF}") private String mode="OFF";
    @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value("${local-candle.price-max-age-seconds:15}") private long maxAge=15;
    @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value("${local-candle.price-future-skew-seconds:2}") private long futureSkew=2;
    private static final org.slf4j.Logger log=org.slf4j.LoggerFactory.getLogger(MarketPriceEventService.class);
    private final java.util.Set<Long> inFlight=java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
    public static final String DIRECT_SOURCE="BINANCE_KLINE_DIRECT_FIX153";
    public static BigDecimal normalizePrice(BigDecimal price){
        return price==null?null:price.setScale(PRICE_SCALE,java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }
    private Instant referenceNow(){Instant local=Instant.now();return exchangeClock==null?local:exchangeClock.correctJvm(local);}
    public String invalidReason(BigDecimal price,Instant observed,Instant now){
        if(price==null || price.signum()<=0)return "INVALID_PRICE";
        if(observed==null)return "MISSING_TIMESTAMP";
        if(observed.isAfter(now.plusSeconds(futureSkew)))return "FUTURE_TIMESTAMP";
        if(observed.isBefore(now.minusSeconds(maxAge)))return "STALE_PRICE";
        return null;
    }
    /** FIX-153: called in INPUT transaction. Invalid observations never occupy slot 1.
     * A duplicate-key error is classified only if the exact canonical key exists; other
     * duplicate constraints/errors propagate. JDBC statement errors do not poison a JPA proxy TX. */
    public Long recordPending(String symbol,BigDecimal price,Instant observed){
        BigDecimal normalizedPrice=normalizePrice(price);
        Instant now=referenceNow();String invalid=invalidReason(normalizedPrice,observed,now);
        if(invalid!=null){
            com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.PROTECTION_REJECTED);
            Long ageMs=observed==null?null:java.time.Duration.between(observed,now).toMillis();
            log.info("[FIX-153][PRICE_NOT_CANONICAL] symbol={}, price={}, observedUtc={}, observationAgeMs={}, reason={}",symbol,normalizedPrice,observed,ageMs,invalid);
            return null;
        }
        org.springframework.jdbc.support.GeneratedKeyHolder keys=new org.springframework.jdbc.support.GeneratedKeyHolder();
        try {
            jdbcTemplate.update(connection->{
                var ps=connection.prepareStatement("INSERT INTO market_price_event(symbol,observed_at,price,source,delivery_status,ordering_slot) VALUES(?,?,?,?,'PENDING',1)",new String[]{"id"});
                ps.setString(1,symbol);ps.setTimestamp(2,Timestamp.from(observed));ps.setBigDecimal(3,normalizedPrice);ps.setString(4,DIRECT_SOURCE);return ps;
            },keys);
            long id=java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(keys.getKey(),"generated price id").longValue();inFlight.add(id);return id;
        }catch(org.springframework.dao.DuplicateKeyException duplicate){
            var first=jdbcTemplate.queryForList("SELECT id,price FROM market_price_event WHERE symbol=? AND observed_at=? AND ordering_slot=1",symbol,Timestamp.from(observed));
            if(first.size()!=1)throw duplicate;
            BigDecimal existing=(BigDecimal)first.getFirst().get("price");
            log.warn("[FIX-153][EQUAL_TIMESTAMP_REJECTED] symbol={}, observedUtc={}, firstEvent={}, firstPrice={}, rejectedPrice={}, observationAgeMs={}, priceDisagreement={}",symbol,observed,first.getFirst().get("id"),existing,normalizedPrice,java.time.Duration.between(observed,now).toMillis(),existing.compareTo(normalizedPrice)!=0);
            jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO market_price_event(symbol,observed_at,price,source,delivery_status,ordering_slot,outcome_reason) VALUES(?,?,?,?,'NON_CANONICAL',NULL,?)",symbol,Timestamp.from(observed),normalizedPrice,DIRECT_SOURCE,existing.compareTo(normalizedPrice)==0?"DUPLICATE_TIMESTAMP":"AMBIGUOUS_EQUAL_TIMESTAMP");
            com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.PROTECTION_REJECTED);return null;
        }
    }
    public void release(long id){inFlight.remove(id);}
    /** Runs after existing symbol/position lock at READ_COMMITTED, never counts unresolved receipts. */
    public boolean laterApplied(String symbol,Instant observed){
        return !jdbcTemplate.queryForList("SELECT id FROM market_price_event WHERE symbol=? AND observed_at>? AND source IN ('BINANCE_KLINE_LIVE_CLOSE',?) AND delivery_status IN ('LEGACY','APPLIED') ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1",symbol,Timestamp.from(observed),DIRECT_SOURCE).isEmpty();
    }
    /** Exact event lineage prevents a caller from completing a different receipt.
     * A lost resolver race rolls back the entire effects transaction. Slot 1 is retained. */
    public void finish(long id,String symbol,Instant observed,BigDecimal price,String state,String reason){
        price=normalizePrice(price);
        if(!org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive())
            throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-153 price outcome requires effects transaction");
        if(!java.util.Set.of("APPLIED","NON_CANONICAL").contains(state))throw new IllegalArgumentException("FIX-153 invalid effects outcome");
        int n=jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE market_price_event SET delivery_status=?,outcome_reason=? WHERE id=? AND source=? AND symbol=? AND observed_at=? AND price=? AND ordering_slot=1 AND delivery_status='PENDING'",state,reason,id,DIRECT_SOURCE,symbol,Timestamp.from(observed),price);
        if(n!=1)throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-153 price outcome ownership/lineage changed: event="+id);
        org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(new org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronization(){
            @Override public void afterCompletion(int status){
                if(status==STATUS_COMMITTED){
                    com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count("APPLIED".equals(state)?com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.PROTECTION_APPLIED:com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.PROTECTION_REJECTED);
                    if("APPLIED".equals(state))com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.protection(symbol,observed);
                    log.info("[FIX-153][PRICE_OUTCOME_COMMITTED] event={}, symbol={}, observedUtc={}, observedKsa={}, outcome={}, reason={}",id,symbol,observed,observed.atOffset(java.time.ZoneOffset.ofHours(3)),state,reason);
                }else log.debug("[FIX-153][PRICE_OUTCOME_NOT_COMMITTED] event={}, symbol={}, proposedOutcome={}, transactionCompletion={}; durable outcome must be read",id,symbol,state,status);
            }
        });
    }
    /** Startup and periodic conditional resolution: no replay and no symbol-entry fence.
     * The conditional update waits behind an in-flight effect TX and cannot override APPLIED.
     * Runtime absence alone is insufficient; candidates must also exceed a configured bound. */
    @org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled(initialDelayString="${local-candle.resolver-initial-delay-ms:5000}",fixedDelayString="${local-candle.resolver-delay-ms:5000}")
    public void resolvePending(){
        if(!"OFF".equals(mode))return;
        try {
            // FIX-153: housekeeping uses its own statement timeout, without mutating the shared template.
            var bounded=new JdbcTemplate(java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(jdbcTemplate.getDataSource()));bounded.setQueryTimeout(2);
            long deadline=System.nanoTime()+java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(2);
            var rows=bounded.queryForList("SELECT id,symbol,observed_at FROM market_price_event WHERE source=? AND delivery_status='PENDING' AND created_at<? ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 100",DIRECT_SOURCE,Timestamp.from(Instant.now().minusSeconds(120)));
            for(var row:rows){if(System.nanoTime()>deadline)break;long id=((Number)row.get("id")).longValue();if(inFlight.contains(id))continue;
                int n=bounded.update("UPDATE market_price_event SET delivery_status='PROTECTION_NOT_APPLIED',outcome_reason='AUTOMATIC_ATOMIC_NO_COMMIT' WHERE id=? AND source=? AND delivery_status='PENDING'",id,DIRECT_SOURCE);
                if(n==1){com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.PROTECTION_PENDING_RESOLVED);
                    log.info("[FIX-153][PENDING_RESOLVED] event={}, symbol={}, observedUtc={}, outcome=PROTECTION_NOT_APPLIED, evidence=ATOMIC_EFFECTS_AND_STATUS_NO_COMMIT, replay=false",id,row.get("symbol"),row.get("observed_at"));}
            }
        }catch(RuntimeException failure){log.warn("[FIX-153][PENDING_RESOLUTION_FAILED] durable outcome unchanged; no live fence introduced",failure);}
    }

    public List<PriceEvent> find(String rawSymbol, Instant startInclusive, Instant endInclusive) {
        String symbol = rawSymbol == null ? "" : rawSymbol.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return jdbcTemplate.query("""
                SELECT observed_at, price, source
                FROM market_price_event
                WHERE delivery_status IN ('LEGACY','APPLIED') AND symbol = ? AND observed_at >= ? AND observed_at <= ?
                ORDER BY observed_at ASC, id ASC
                """, (rs, rowNum) -> new PriceEvent(
                        rs.getTimestamp("observed_at").toInstant(),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("price"), rs.getString("source")),
                symbol, Timestamp.from(startInclusive), Timestamp.from(endInclusive));
    }


    /** FIX-056: newest canonical live-price observation at or before the execution clock. */
    public java.util.Optional<PriceEvent> findLatestAtOrBefore(String rawSymbol, Instant reference) {
        String symbol = rawSymbol == null ? "" : rawSymbol.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        List<PriceEvent> rows = jdbcTemplate.query("""
                SELECT observed_at, price, source
                FROM market_price_event
                WHERE delivery_status IN ('LEGACY','APPLIED') AND symbol = ? AND observed_at <= ?
                ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """, (rs, rowNum) -> new PriceEvent(
                        rs.getTimestamp("observed_at").toInstant(),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("price"), rs.getString("source")),
                symbol, Timestamp.from(reference));
        return rows.stream().findFirst();
    }

    /** FIX-132: known skipped/unconfirmed collector delivery must not silently
     * become legacy candle-price fallback. Historical pre-collector windows retain
     * their established fallback. This reads immutable evidence, never live claims. */
    public void assertReplayEvidence(String symbol,Instant from,Instant to) {
        Long pending=jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_price_event WHERE symbol=? AND observed_at BETWEEN ? AND ? AND delivery_status='PENDING'",
            Long.class,symbol,Timestamp.from(from),Timestamp.from(to));
        if(pending!=null && pending>0)throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-132 Replay contains unconfirmed Production price outcomes; reconcile before claiming parity");
        // FIX-153 OFF Replay never queries collector-era activation tables.
        if("OFF".equals(mode))return;
        Long cutovers=jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shared_market_cutover_history WHERE symbol=? AND cutover_at<=?",Long.class,symbol,Timestamp.from(to));
        if(cutovers!=null && cutovers>0) {
            Long applied=jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_price_event WHERE symbol=? AND observed_at BETWEEN ? AND ? AND delivery_status IN ('LEGACY','APPLIED')",
                Long.class,symbol,Timestamp.from(from),Timestamp.from(to));
            if(applied==null || applied==0)throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-132 no applied price evidence in collector-era Replay window; signal-price fallback is not Production reproduction");
        }
    }

    /** FIX-153: report excluded evidence explicitly; this never promotes it to a Replay price. */
    public java.util.Map<String,Long> replayOutcomeCounts(String symbol,Instant from,Instant to){
        java.util.Map<String,Long> result=new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        jdbcTemplate.query("SELECT delivery_status,COUNT(*) AS n FROM market_price_event WHERE symbol=? AND observed_at BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY delivery_status",
            (org.springframework.jdbc.core.RowCallbackHandler)rs->result.put(rs.getString(1),rs.getLong(2)),symbol,Timestamp.from(from),Timestamp.from(to));
        return result;
    }

    public record PriceEvent(Instant observedAt, BigDecimal price, String source) {
        public PriceEvent(Instant observedAt,BigDecimal price) { this(observedAt,price,"BINANCE_KLINE_LIVE_CLOSE"); }
    }
}


===== src/main/java/com/crypto/infrastructure/diagnostics/JdbcTimingDataSource.java =====
package com.crypto.infrastructure.diagnostics;

import javax.sql.DataSource;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.lang.reflect.*;
import java.sql.*;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

/** FIX-142: JDBC boundary timing for local JPA/JdbcTemplate and collector reads.
 * Only redacted SQL templates are emitted; bind values are never emitted. A bounded, nonblocking log queue isolates
 * trading threads from log I/O; dropped diagnostics are reported, never hidden.
 * Execute, result traversal, acquisition and commit are separate measurements.
 * These timings are NOT rows examined, server lock waits, or buffer-pool reads. */
public final class JdbcTimingDataSource implements DataSource, AutoCloseable {
    private static final org.slf4j.Logger LOG=LoggerFactory.getLogger("FIX142.DatabaseTiming");
    private static final org.slf4j.Logger STATUS_LOG=LoggerFactory.getLogger(JdbcTimingDataSource.class);
    private static final ArrayBlockingQueue<String> EVENTS=new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(2048);
    private static final AtomicLong DROPPED=new AtomicLong();
    private static final AtomicLong IDS=new AtomicLong();
    private static final AtomicLong OMITTED_AGGREGATES=new AtomicLong();
    private static final AtomicLong TOTAL_DROPPED=new AtomicLong();
    private static final ConcurrentHashMap<String,Aggregate> AGGREGATES=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final ThreadLocal<String> CONTEXT=ThreadLocal.withInitial(()->"NONE");
    private static final class Aggregate {
        final LongAdder count=new LongAdder(),failed=new LongAdder(),elapsedMs=new LongAdder();
    }
    /** Bounded labels; never use SQL/event IDs as metric keys. */
    public static java.util.Map<String,Object> statistics() {
        var result=new java.util.LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
        AGGREGATES.forEach((key,value)->result.put(key,java.util.Map.of("count",value.count.sum(),"failed",value.failed.sum(),"totalMs",value.elapsedMs.sum())));
        result.put("aggregateSamplesOmitted",OMITTED_AGGREGATES.get());result.put("queueCapacity",2048);result.put("queueDepth",EVENTS.size());result.put("droppedTotal",TOTAL_DROPPED.get());return result;
    }
    public interface Scope extends AutoCloseable { void close(); }
    public static Scope context(String detail) {
        String previous=CONTEXT.get();CONTEXT.set(detail);return ()->CONTEXT.set(previous);
    }
    public static void diagnostic(String line){offer(line);}
    private static void offer(String line){if(line.length()>4096)line=line.substring(0,4096)+" detailTruncated=true";if(!EVENTS.offer(line)){DROPPED.incrementAndGet();TOTAL_DROPPED.incrementAndGet();}}

    static {
        Thread writer=new Thread(()->{
            while(!Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
                try {
                    String item=EVENTS.poll(1,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
                    if(item!=null)LOG.info("{}",item);
                    long lost=DROPPED.getAndSet(0);
                    if(lost>0)STATUS_LOG.warn("[FIX-142][DIAGNOSTICS_DROPPED] count={}; log queue saturated",lost);
                } catch(InterruptedException e){Thread.currentThread().interrupt();}
                  catch(RuntimeException ignored){DROPPED.incrementAndGet();}
            }
        },"fix142-db-log-writer"); writer.setDaemon(true);writer.start();
    }
    private final DataSource delegate;
    private final String pool;
    private final long slowMs;
    public JdbcTimingDataSource(DataSource delegate,String pool,long slowMs) {
        this.delegate=delegate;this.pool=pool;this.slowMs=slowMs;
    }
    private void emit(String event,String id,String tx,Instant start,long nanos,Throwable failure,String detail) {
        long duration=(System.nanoTime()-nanos)/1_000_000;
        String state=failure instanceof SQLException s?s.getSQLState():failure==null?"NONE":failure.getClass().getSimpleName();
        Instant end=Instant.now();
        String line="[FIX-142]["+event+"] id="+id+" pool="+pool+" transaction="+tx+
            " startUtc="+start+" endUtc="+end+" startKsa="+start.atOffset(java.time.ZoneOffset.ofHours(3))+" endKsa="+end.atOffset(java.time.ZoneOffset.ofHours(3))+" durationMs="+duration+
            " context="+CONTEXT.get()+" outcome="+(failure==null?"SUCCESS":"FAILED")+" sqlState="+state+" "+detail+
            (duration>=slowMs?" [FIX-142][SLOW_QUERY]":"");
        String key=pool+":"+event+":"+detail.replaceAll(" fingerprint=.*", "").replaceAll(" (?:rowsReturned|batchEntries|affectedRows)=.*", "");
        Aggregate aggregate=AGGREGATES.get(key);
        if(aggregate==null) {
            synchronized(AGGREGATES){aggregate=AGGREGATES.get(key);if(aggregate==null && AGGREGATES.size()<1024){aggregate=new Aggregate();AGGREGATES.put(key,aggregate);}}
        }
        if(aggregate!=null){aggregate.count.increment();aggregate.elapsedMs.add(duration);if(failure!=null)aggregate.failed.increment();}else OMITTED_AGGREGATES.incrementAndGet();
        offer(line);
    }
    private void started(String event,String id,String tx,Instant start,String detail) {
        offer("[FIX-142]["+event+"_START] id="+id+" pool="+pool+
                " transaction="+tx+" startUtc="+start+" startKsa="+start.atOffset(java.time.ZoneOffset.ofHours(3))+" context="+CONTEXT.get()+" "+detail);
    }
    private static Object call(Object target,Method method,Object[] args)throws Throwable {
        try{return method.invoke(target,args);}catch(InvocationTargetException e){throw e.getCause();}
    }
    private static String component() {
        return StackWalker.getInstance().walk(s->s.filter(f->f.getClassName().startsWith("com.crypto.")
            && !f.getClassName().startsWith("com.crypto.infrastructure.diagnostics."))
            .findFirst().map(f->f.getClassName()+"#"+f.getMethodName()).orElse("FRAMEWORK"));
    }
    static String safeTemplate(String sql) {
        if(sql==null)return "UNKNOWN";
        StringBuilder text=new StringBuilder();
        for(int i=0;i<sql.length();) {
            char c=sql.charAt(i);
            if(c=='\''||c=='"') {
                char quote=c;text.append('?');i++;
                while(i<sql.length()) {
                    char value=sql.charAt(i++);
                    if(value=='\\'&&i<sql.length()){i++;continue;}
                    if(value==quote){if(i<sql.length()&&sql.charAt(i)==quote){i++;continue;}break;}
                }
            } else if(i+1<sql.length()&&c=='/'&&sql.charAt(i+1)=='*') {
                int end=sql.indexOf("*/",i+2);i=end<0?sql.length():end+2;text.append(' ');
            } else if(c=='#'||(i+1<sql.length()&&c=='-'&&sql.charAt(i+1)=='-')) {
                int end=sql.indexOf('\n',i);i=end<0?sql.length():end+1;text.append(' ');
            } else {text.append(c);i++;}
        }
        return text.toString().replaceAll("(?i)\\b0x[0-9a-f]+\\b","?")
            .replaceAll("\\b[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?\\b","?").replaceAll("\\s+"," ").strip();
    }
    private static String shape(String sql) {
        String clean=safeTemplate(sql);
        String operation=clean.isEmpty()?"UNKNOWN":clean.split("\\s+",2)[0].toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
        if(!java.util.Set.of("SELECT","INSERT","UPDATE","DELETE","ALTER","CREATE","SET","WITH").contains(operation))operation="OTHER";
        var matcher=java.util.regex.Pattern.compile("(?i)\\b(?:FROM|INTO|UPDATE|TABLE)\\s+((?:`?[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,80}`?\\.)?`?[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,80}`?)").matcher(clean);
        return "operation="+operation+" table="+(matcher.find()?matcher.group(1):"UNKNOWN")
            +" fingerprint="+Integer.toHexString(clean.hashCode())+" sqlTemplate="+clean.substring(0,Math.min(512,clean.length()));
    }
    private Connection acquire(String user,String password,boolean supplied)throws SQLException {
        String id=Long.toString(IDS.incrementAndGet());Instant start=Instant.now();long n=System.nanoTime();
        started("CONNECTION_ACQUIRE",id,"NONE",start,"");
        Connection c=null;
        try {
            c=supplied?delegate.getConnection(user,password):delegate.getConnection();
            Connection wrapped=wrap(c,id);emit("CONNECTION_ACQUIRE",id,"NONE",start,n,null,"");return wrapped;
        }catch(SQLException e){
            if(c!=null)try{c.close();}catch(SQLException close){e.addSuppressed(close);}
            emit("CONNECTION_ACQUIRE",id,"NONE",start,n,e,"");throw e;
        }
    }
    private Connection wrap(Connection connection,String connectionId) throws SQLException {
        class Handler implements InvocationHandler {
            boolean autoCommit;
            String tx="NONE";Instant txStart;long txNanos;
            Handler() throws SQLException {autoCommit=connection.getAutoCommit();}
            String transactionId() {
                if(autoCommit)return "AUTOCOMMIT";
                if(txStart==null){tx=UUID.randomUUID().toString();txStart=Instant.now();txNanos=System.nanoTime();started("TRANSACTION",connectionId,tx,txStart,"component="+component());}
                return tx;
            }
            void finish(Throwable failure,String resolution) {
                if(txStart!=null)emit("TRANSACTION",connectionId,tx,txStart,txNanos,failure,"resolution="+resolution);
                txStart=null;tx="NONE";
            }
            public Object invoke(Object proxy,Method method,Object[] args)throws Throwable {
                String name=method.getName();
                if(name.equals("unwrap")&&((Class<?>)args[0]).isInstance(proxy))return proxy;
                if(name.equals("isWrapperFor")&&((Class<?>)args[0]).isInstance(proxy))return true;
                if(name.equals("setAutoCommit")) {
                    boolean next=(Boolean)args[0];
                    // Keep the original span identity after finish() clears the active transaction.
                    String current=tx;
                    Instant start=Instant.now();long n=System.nanoTime();Throwable failure=null;
                    started("AUTOCOMMIT_CHANGE",connectionId,current,start,"enabled="+next);
                    try {
                        Object result=call(connection,method,args);
                        if(next&&!autoCommit)finish(null,"COMMITTED_BY_AUTOCOMMIT_CHANGE");
                        autoCommit=next;return result;
                    }catch(Throwable error){failure=error;throw error;}
                    finally{emit("AUTOCOMMIT_CHANGE",connectionId,current,start,n,failure,"enabled="+next);}

                }
                if(name.equals("commit")||name.equals("rollback")) {
                    boolean savepoint=name.equals("rollback")&&args!=null&&args.length==1;
                    String event=savepoint?"ROLLBACK_TO_SAVEPOINT":name.toUpperCase();
                    Instant start=Instant.now();long n=System.nanoTime();Throwable failure=null;
                    String current=transactionId();started(event,connectionId,current,start,"component="+component());
                    try{return call(connection,method,args);}catch(Throwable e){failure=e;throw e;}
                    finally {
                        String resolution=failure!=null?"UNKNOWN":savepoint?"SAVEPOINT_ONLY":name.equals("commit")?"COMMITTED":"ROLLED_BACK";
                        emit(event,connectionId,current,start,n,failure,"resolution="+resolution);
                        if(!savepoint)finish(failure,resolution);
                    }
                }
                if(name.equals("close")) {
                    // A failed close must not be reported as a successful unresolved closure.
                    Throwable failure=null;
                    try{return call(connection,method,args);}catch(Throwable error){failure=error;throw error;}
                    finally{finish(failure,"CONNECTION_CLOSED_UNRESOLVED");}
                }
                Object result=call(connection,method,args);
                if(result instanceof Statement st && (name.equals("prepareStatement")||name.equals("prepareCall")||name.equals("createStatement"))) {
                    String sql=args!=null&&args.length>0&&args[0] instanceof String text?text:null;
                    return statement(st,sql,this::transactionId,(Connection)proxy);
                }
                return result;
            }
        }
        return (Connection)Proxy.newProxyInstance(Connection.class.getClassLoader(),new Class[]{Connection.class},new Handler());
    }
    private Statement statement(Statement statement,String prepared,java.util.function.Supplier<String> tx,Connection connection) {
        Class<?> type=statement instanceof CallableStatement?CallableStatement.class:statement instanceof PreparedStatement?PreparedStatement.class:Statement.class;
        java.util.Map<ResultSet,ResultSet> results=new java.util.IdentityHashMap<>();
        java.util.List<String> batches=new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        AtomicLong batchCount=new AtomicLong();
        return (Statement)Proxy.newProxyInstance(type.getClassLoader(),new Class[]{type},(proxy,method,args)->{
            if(method.getName().equals("unwrap")&&((Class<?>)args[0]).isInstance(proxy))return proxy;
            if(method.getName().equals("isWrapperFor")&&((Class<?>)args[0]).isInstance(proxy))return true;
            if(method.getName().equals("addBatch")) {
                Object value=call(statement,method,args);
                batchCount.incrementAndGet();if(batches.size()<8)batches.add(shape(prepared!=null?prepared:args!=null&&args.length>0?(String)args[0]:null));
                return value;
            }
            if(method.getName().equals("clearBatch")){Object value=call(statement,method,args);batches.clear();batchCount.set(0);return value;}
            if(method.getName().equals("getConnection"))return connection;
            if(method.getName().equals("close")) {
                // JDBC closes result sets implicitly with their statement. Complete fetch spans
                // without adding extra driver close calls or changing the driver's exception.
                Throwable failure=null;
                try{return call(statement,method,args);}catch(Throwable error){failure=error;throw error;}
                finally{
                    for(ResultSet wrapped:results.values())((FetchCompletion)Proxy.getInvocationHandler(wrapped)).complete(failure);
                    results.clear();
                }
            }
            if(method.getName().startsWith("execute")) {
                String sql=prepared!=null?prepared:args!=null&&args.length>0&&args[0] instanceof String s?s:null;
                String detail="component="+component()+" "+shape(sql)+(method.getName().contains("Batch")?" batchEntries="+batchCount.get()+" templatesFirst8="+String.join(";",batches):"");String currentTx=tx.get();String id=Long.toString(IDS.incrementAndGet());
                Instant start=Instant.now();long n=System.nanoTime();Throwable failure=null;
                final String fetchDetail=detail;
                started("SQL",id,currentTx,start,detail);
                try {Object result=call(statement,method,args);if(result instanceof Number count)detail+=" affectedRows="+count;else if(result instanceof int[] batchCounts)detail+=" affectedRows="+java.util.Arrays.toString(batchCounts);return result instanceof ResultSet r?results.computeIfAbsent(r,key->resultSet(key,id,currentTx,fetchDetail,(Statement)proxy)):result;}
                catch(Throwable e){failure=e;throw e;}finally{emit("SQL",id,currentTx,start,n,failure,detail);if(method.getName().contains("Batch")){batches.clear();batchCount.set(0);}}
            }
            Object result=call(statement,method,args);
            return result instanceof ResultSet r?results.computeIfAbsent(r,key->resultSet(key,Long.toString(IDS.incrementAndGet()),tx.get(),shape(prepared),(Statement)proxy)):result;
        });
    }
    private interface FetchCompletion { void complete(Throwable failure); }
    private ResultSet resultSet(ResultSet result,String id,String tx,String detail,Statement owner) {
        Instant start=Instant.now();started("FETCH",id,tx,start,detail);long n=System.nanoTime();AtomicLong rows=new AtomicLong();AtomicBoolean ended=new AtomicBoolean();
        class FetchHandler implements InvocationHandler,FetchCompletion {
            public void complete(Throwable failure) {
                if(ended.compareAndSet(false,true))emit("FETCH",id,tx,start,n,failure,detail+" rowsReturned="+rows.get());
            }
            public Object invoke(Object proxy,Method method,Object[] args)throws Throwable {
            // Preserve the decorated JDBC object graph so getStatement() cannot bypass timing.
            if(method.getName().equals("getStatement"))return owner;
            if(method.getName().equals("unwrap")&&((Class<?>)args[0]).isInstance(proxy))return proxy;
            if(method.getName().equals("isWrapperFor")&&((Class<?>)args[0]).isInstance(proxy))return true;
            try {
                Object value=call(result,method,args);
                if(method.getName().equals("next")&&Boolean.TRUE.equals(value))rows.incrementAndGet();
                if(method.getName().equals("close")||(method.getName().equals("next")&&Boolean.FALSE.equals(value)))complete(null);
                return value;
            }catch(Throwable e){complete(e);throw e;}
            }
        }
        return (ResultSet)Proxy.newProxyInstance(ResultSet.class.getClassLoader(),new Class[]{ResultSet.class},new FetchHandler());
    }
    public Connection getConnection()throws SQLException{return acquire(null,null,false);}
    public Connection getConnection(String u,String p)throws SQLException{return acquire(u,p,true);}
    public PrintWriter getLogWriter()throws SQLException{return delegate.getLogWriter();}
    public void setLogWriter(PrintWriter p)throws SQLException{delegate.setLogWriter(p);}
    public void setLoginTimeout(int t)throws SQLException{delegate.setLoginTimeout(t);}
    public int getLoginTimeout()throws SQLException{return delegate.getLoginTimeout();}
    public Logger getParentLogger()throws SQLFeatureNotSupportedException{return delegate.getParentLogger();}
    public <T>T unwrap(Class<T> c)throws SQLException{return c.isInstance(this)?c.cast(this):delegate.unwrap(c);}
    public boolean isWrapperFor(Class<?> c)throws SQLException{return c.isInstance(this)||delegate.isWrapperFor(c);}
    public void close()throws Exception{if(delegate instanceof AutoCloseable c)c.close();}
}


===== src/main/java/com/crypto/audit/service/ProductionExitAuditService.java =====
package com.crypto.audit.service;

import com.crypto.audit.domain.ProductionExitAudit;
import com.crypto.audit.repository.ProductionExitAuditRepository;
import com.crypto.domain.PaperPosition;
import com.crypto.domain.TradeSignal;
import com.crypto.position.domain.PositionAnalysis;
import com.crypto.position.repository.PositionAnalysisRepository;
import com.crypto.wallet.domain.WalletManagedPosition;
import com.crypto.wallet.repository.WalletManagedPositionRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.time.Instant;

/**
 * FIX-028: records the actual production exit cause without changing execution.
 *
 * Example that motivated the audit: BTC hit TAKE_PROFIT while the latest 1m signal
 * was WATCH. The legacy wallet ledger called that SIGNAL_SELL because it reused the
 * current signal as an execution carrier. This service preserves both facts:
 * closeTrigger=TAKE_PROFIT and sourceSignalDecision=WATCH.
 */
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ProductionExitAuditService {
    private final ProductionExitAuditRepository auditRepository;
    private final WalletManagedPositionRepository managedPositionRepository;
    private final PositionAnalysisRepository positionAnalysisRepository;

    @Transactional
    public void record(PaperPosition paper, TradeSignal sourceSignal, String closeTrigger, String explanation) {
        if (paper == null || paper.getId() == null || paper.getExitPrice() == null || closeTrigger == null) return;
        if (auditRepository.findTopByPaperPositionIdOrderByAuditedAtDesc(paper.getId()).isPresent()) return;

        WalletManagedPosition managed = paper.getSignal() == null ? null : managedPositionRepository
                .findTopByEntrySignalIdOrderByOpenedAtDesc(paper.getSignal().getId()).orElse(null);
        PositionAnalysis analysis = managed == null || managed.getId() == null ? null : positionAnalysisRepository
                .findTopByWalletPositionIdOrderByAnalyzedAtDesc(managed.getId()).orElse(null);

        auditRepository.save(ProductionExitAudit.builder()
                .paperPositionId(paper.getId())
                .walletPositionId(managed == null ? null : managed.getId())
                .symbol(paper.getSymbol())
                .closeTrigger(closeTrigger)
                .sourceSignalId(sourceSignal == null ? null : sourceSignal.getId())
                .sourceSignalDecision(sourceSignal == null || sourceSignal.getDecision() == null ? null : sourceSignal.getDecision().name())
                .sourceSignalOriginalDecision(sourceSignal == null || sourceSignal.getOriginalDecision() == null ? null : sourceSignal.getOriginalDecision().name())
                .positionAnalysisId(analysis == null ? null : analysis.getId())
                .positionRecommendation(analysis == null || analysis.getRecommendation() == null ? null : analysis.getRecommendation().name())
                .entryPriceUsdt(paper.getEntryPrice())
                .exitPriceUsdt(paper.getExitPrice())
                .stopLossUsdt(paper.getStopLoss())
                .takeProfitUsdt(paper.getTakeProfit())
                .closeExplanation(explanation)
                .auditedAt(Instant.now())
                .build());
    }
}

                log.info("[FIX-118][PRODUCTION][SIGNAL_PATH] signalId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, interval={}, price={}, " +
                                "active={}, progressPct={}, activationPct={}, lock={}, state={}, triggered={}",
                        signal.getId(), profitLock.walletPositionId(), symbol, signal.getInterval(), price,
                        profitLock.active(), profitLock.progressPercent(), profitLock.activationPercent(),
                        profitLock.lockPrice(), profitLock.state(), profitLock.triggered());
            }

            // FIX-067: The wallet-managed position is the authoritative Production source for
            // a dynamically extended take-profit.  paper_position historically retained the
            // entry-time TP, so a fresh 1m signal could close against that stale threshold even
            // after LivePositionProtectionService had persisted TAKE_PROFIT_EXTENDED.
            // Prefer the OPEN managed TP and repair the paper snapshot when they differ. This is
            // deliberately NOT a TP-policy change: it only makes both existing exit paths compare
            // against the same already-approved target.
            BigDecimal authoritativeTakeProfit = position.getTakeProfit();
            WalletManagedPosition managedPosition = walletManagedPositionRepository
                    .findTopBySymbolAndStatusOrderByOpenedAtDesc(symbol, "OPEN")
                    .orElse(null);
            if (managedPosition != null && managedPosition.getTakeProfitUsdt() != null) {
                authoritativeTakeProfit = managedPosition.getTakeProfitUsdt();
                if (position.getTakeProfit() == null
                        || position.getTakeProfit().compareTo(authoritativeTakeProfit) != 0) {
                    position.setTakeProfit(authoritativeTakeProfit);
                    positionRepository.save(position);
                }
            }

            if (authoritativePrice && authoritativeTakeProfit != null
                    && price.compareTo(authoritativeTakeProfit) >= 0) {
                return Optional.of(closeFromSignal(position, signal, PositionStatus.CLOSED,
                        "TAKE_PROFIT", "Price reached the authoritative configured take-profit target."));
            }

            if (authoritativePrice && profitLock.triggered()) {
                log.info("[FIX-118][PRODUCTION][SIGNAL_TRIGGER] signalId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, price={}, lock={}, progressPct={}",
                        signal.getId(), profitLock.walletPositionId(), symbol, price, profitLock.lockPrice(), profitLock.progressPercent());
                return Optional.of(closeFromProfitLock(position, signal, profitLock));
            }

            if (authoritativePrice && price.compareTo(position.getStopLoss()) <= 0) {
                return Optional.of(closeFromSignal(position, signal, PositionStatus.STOPPED,
                        "STOP_LOSS", "Price reached the configured stop loss."));
            }

            // FIX-118: in TP_EXTENSION_REBASE the old Profit Lock cannot execute, but the
            // direct protected-profit floor still applies. Stop Loss remains absolute and
            // therefore keeps priority immediately above this branch.
            if (authoritativePrice && profitLock.hardProfitFloorTriggered()) {
                log.info("[FIX-118][PRODUCTION][SIGNAL_REBASE_HARD_FLOOR] signalId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, price={}, floor={}",
                        signal.getId(), profitLock.walletPositionId(), symbol, price, profitLock.hardProfitFloor());
                return Optional.of(closeFromSignal(position, signal, PositionStatus.CLOSED,
                        "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", profitLock.explanation()));
            }

    private boolean sameDecimal(BigDecimal a, BigDecimal b) {
        return a == null ? b == null : b != null && a.compareTo(b) == 0;
    }

    private void closePaper(String symbol, BigDecimal exitPrice, PositionStatus status,
                            String closeReason, String explanation, TradeSignal sourceSignal) {
        PaperPosition paper = paperPositionRepository.findBySymbolAndStatus(symbol, PositionStatus.OPEN).orElse(null);
        if (paper == null) return;
        BigDecimal remainingPnl = exitPrice.subtract(paper.getEntryPrice(), MC).multiply(paper.getQuantity(), MC);
        // FIX-11T: paper_position may already contain realized P&L from a Near-TP partial
        // harvest. Preserve it when the remaining quantity is later closed.
        BigDecimal pnl = (paper.getRealizedPnl() == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : paper.getRealizedPnl())
                .add(remainingPnl, MC);
        paper.setExitPrice(exitPrice);
        paper.setRealizedPnl(pnl);
        paper.setStatus(status);
        paper.setCloseReason(closeReason);
        paper.setExitReason(explanation);
        paper.setClosedAt(Instant.now());
        PaperPosition saved = paperPositionRepository.save(paper);

        // FIX-028: live-price exits (TP/SL/Profit Lock/normal exit) also write the
        // immutable audit record. sourceSignal is context only unless the closeTrigger
        // itself is a genuine SELL decision. No protection/exit policy is changed here.
        productionExitAuditService.record(saved, sourceSignal, closeReason, explanation);
    }
}
